# Dark Executive Redesign Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Restyle every public BCH Taxi page in the owner-approved "B · Dark executive" look, with a fleet showcase, without changing content, admin or booking behaviour.

**Architecture:** The site is static HTML generated by `build/build.py` from `build/templates/index.html` plus Python helpers, styled by `css/style.css` (base + home) and `css/pages.css` (subpages). Most of the work is CSS. The markup changes are:
- a hero eyebrow text key;
- a new homepage fleet showcase that replaces the fleet strip;
- spec-sheet vehicle cards on the Fleet page.

Behaviour in `js/main.js`, `js/places.js` and `js/fares.js` is kept. The only new JS is the small fleet-tab switcher.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.14 build + Flask admin, plain CSS, vanilla JS, pytest, Google Fonts (Geist + Instrument Serif).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-dark-executive-redesign-design.md` (mockup: `2026-11-08-dark-executive-redesign-mockup.png`, the middle design "B").

## Global Constraints

- Work on a new branch `design/executive` cut from `design/modern`. Do not merge, push or deploy. Nothing goes live until the owner says go.
- No content changes. The only new copy is the default headline "Arrive the way" / "you planned." (`home.hero_title` / `home.hero_title_gold`) and the eyebrow "Private transport · Ireland" (new key `home.hero_eyebrow`). Owner overrides always win.
- `/admin` and `server/` stay unchanged, apart from what new text keys bring in automatically.
- Colours: page `#0B0B0C`. Raised surfaces are slightly lighter blacks with hairline borders and no shadows. Yellow `#FFC72C` is used only for primary buttons, the active tab rule and small accents.
- Type: headings in "Instrument Serif" (400). Body and UI in "Geist". Field labels and eyebrows are small, uppercase and letter-spaced. Reading text is at least 17px (the existing minimum).
- Keep visible focus rings, alt text and contrast of at least 4.5:1 for text. No horizontal scroll at 360px.
- All 295 existing tests stay green: `TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql:///bch_taxi_test .venv/bin/pytest -q`. A test that pins old markup may be updated only so that it still guards the same behaviour.
- Booking card features must all survive: Taxi/Tours tabs, address search, vehicle select, instant price, step 2 contact, WhatsApp, `?service=` and `?vehicle=` deep links.

## Review Focus

1. **An owner-edited long headline or eyebrow in `/admin`:** it wraps cleanly over the hero photo without colliding with the booking bar, on both phone and desktop. Covered in Task 3 (test plus a screenshot check with a long override).
2. **Fleet with 0, 1 or 5+ published vehicles, or the van hidden:** the showcase still builds. It shows no tab row for 0 or 1 vehicles, the tabs wrap for 5+, and with the van hidden the first vehicle is featured and no "Tours from" appears. Covered in Task 4.
3. **A vehicle with no photo:** the showcase and the Fleet sheet fall back to the existing `fleet-panel` name panel, not a broken image. Covered in Tasks 4 and 5.
4. **JavaScript off or failing:** every vehicle in the showcase is visible (stacked), and the tabs are hidden. Covered in Task 4.
5. **No published tour has a price:** the van shows its `price_note` instead of "Tours from". Covered in Task 4.

### Task 4: Homepage fleet showcase

**Files:**
- Modify: `build/build.py` (replace `fleet_strip()` at ~1479; add helpers near `vehicle_specs()` ~954)
- Modify: `build/templates/index.html` (`@fleet-strip` region kept as the insertion point; move it to sit after the tours section if it isn't already)
- Modify: `js/main.js` (append the tab switcher)
- Modify: `css/style.css` (replace the fleet-strip / vehicle-mini rules)
- Test: `tests/test_redesign.py`, update `tests/test_fleet_build.py::test_homepage_strip_teasers_and_four_faqs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `fleet_published()`, `vehicle_media(v, root, cls)`, `VAN_SLUG`, `published()`, `eur()`, `T()`
- Produces:
  - `from_price(v) -> int | None`: lowest `price` among `published()` tours whose price is not None, only when `v["slug"] == VAN_SLUG`, else None.
  - `vehicle_spec_grid(v) -> str`: `<dl class="spec-grid">` with 4 cells:
    - Passengers = `passengers`
    - Suitcases = `bags`. Skip the cell when 0.
    - Price = "Tours from €X" via `eur(from_price(v))` when not None, else `price_note` (skip if empty).
    - Fourth cell = "Access: Ramp" when any feature contains "wheelchair" (case-insensitive), else the first feature labelled "Includes".
    - All owner text goes through `E()`.
  - `featured_slug(vehicles) -> str`: `VAN_SLUG` if published, else `vehicles[0]["slug"]`.
  - `fleet_showcase() -> str`: the whole section HTML, used by `build_index`. It also reuses `vehicle_spec_grid` in Task 5.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** (build with `default_content()` unless stated):
  - `test_showcase_features_van`: the section `id="fleet-strip"` contains exactly one `class="showcase-item is-featured"`, and it holds `8-seater`. There are 4 `class="showcase-item` and 4 tab buttons `data-vehicle=`.
  - `test_showcase_van_from_price`: the van item contains `Tours from €` + the min published tour price (compute it in the test from `published()`). The saloon item contains its `price_note` and no `Tours from`.
  - `test_showcase_book_link`: each item links `index.html?vehicle=<slug>#booking` with text `T("fleet.book_button")`.
  - `test_showcase_van_hidden`: with the van unpublished, the first published vehicle is featured and `Tours from` is absent.
  - `test_showcase_single_vehicle_no_tabs`: with one published vehicle there is no `class="showcase-tabs"`. With zero vehicles the region is empty and the build succeeds.
  - `test_showcase_no_priced_tours`: with every tour price None, the van shows its `price_note`.
  - `test_showcase_no_photo_panel`: a vehicle with no photo renders `fleet-panel`.
  - `test_showcase_escapes_owner_text`: a vehicle name `<script>x` appears escaped.
  - Update `test_homepage_strip_teasers_and_four_faqs`: replace the `fleet-mini == 4` count with a `showcase-item` count of 4. The other assertions stay.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run them. Expected: FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Implement the four helpers above. Markup:
  - The section head has a serif `h2` (`home.fleet_title`) and a grey intro (`home.fleet_intro`).
  - Then `<div class="showcase">` with one `<article class="showcase-item" id="sc-<slug>" data-vehicle="<slug>">` per vehicle:
    - photo via `vehicle_media(v, "", "showcase-img")`

    - `example` line
    - `vehicle_spec_grid(v)`
    - yellow `Book this vehicle` link
  - Then `<div class="showcase-tabs" role="tablist" hidden>` with a `<button role="tab" data-vehicle aria-selected>` per vehicle showing name and "N seats · N bags". Render tabs only if there are 2+ vehicles.
  - Keep the `home.fleet_link` "see whole fleet" link.
- [ ] **Step 4:** In `js/main.js`, append a self-contained block. If `.showcase-tabs` exists:
  - unhide it and add `.js-tabs` to `.showcase`;
  - clicking a tab sets `is-featured` on the matching item and `aria-selected` on the tab;

  - CSS: `.showcase.js-tabs .showcase-item:not(.is-featured){display:none}`. Without JS, all items show stacked.
